description: Why: same mismatch as FsStore. A delete operation failing should return a semantically distinct error from a write failure. Callers that branch on WriteFailed to decide whether to retry a write will incorrectly retry on a delete error. What: rados_store.rs delete returns IpfsError::WriteFailed both for the Err branch of rados_object_remove and for the spawn_blocking JoinError. Neither is a write failure; there should be a DeleteFailed variant or ReadFailed should be reused consistently with other backends.
title: rados_store::delete returns IpfsError::WriteFailed for delete errors
